answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The whisper holds work receipts rather than names, so the sonnet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
